blocks.text:
1-Filter PROD Lots -
LOT_OWNER_CD = 'P'(PROD).

2-Extract Planning Items -
Retrieve PLANNING_ITEM_ID as UPI_PLANNING_ITEM_ID, PLANNING_ITEM_DSC AS UPI_PLANNING_ITEM_DSC, and PLANNING_ITEM_CLASS_NM AS UPI_PLANNING_ITEM_CLASS_NM from the view V_BRD_PLANNING_ITEM_SHOP_FLOOR_PRODUCT_ASSOCIATION_CORE_PIT by joining with WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_PIT using PRODUCT_NM = (SHOP_FLOOR_PRODUCT_ITEM_DSC) as the join key.
  2.1-For PLANNING_ITEM_CLASS_NM in UPI_FAB or UPI_BUMP 
     Also join with the PLANNING_STAGE data to map the correct PLANNING_ITEM_CLASS_NM ; -- as same SFP can be associated with both FAB and BUMP 
     if PLANNING_STAGE is 'FAB', the map to PLANNING_ITEM_CLASS_NM = UPI_FAB; 
     if PLANNING_STAGE is 'BUMP', then map to PLANNING_ITEM_CLASS_NM = UPI_BUMP.
 
3-Apply S-Package Logic -
Only for PLANNING_ITEM_CLASS_NM in UPI_SORT and PLANNING_STAGE in ('FAB' or 'FAB_END' or BUMP' or 'BUMP_END') -- (S-PACKAGE)
-create a column PRIOR STAGE UPI ID and set as
     When PLANNING_STAGE is 'BUMP' or 'BUMP_END', utilize PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_BILL_OF_MATERIAL_LOCATION_TRAVERSAL to traverse the BOM  to find related Bump items and capture as PRIOR STAGE UPI ID 
     When PLANNING_STAGE is 'FAB' or 'FAB_END', similarly use the same BOM traversal view to locate the Fab items and capture as PRIOR STAGE UPI ID 
-create a column IS_TRANSFORMED and add S-Package: Current UPI ID ⇒ PRIOR STAGE UPI ID, ''NOT APPLICABLE FOR S PACKAGE''
-create a column FINAL_ITEM_ID AS COALESCE(PRIOR_STAGE_UPI_ID, UNIFIED_PLANNING_ITEM_ID

 3.1 Update LOCATION  -  for s package
Join IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_MESFACILITY_MANUFACTURING_LOCATION_MAPPING_ROOT on PLANNING_OWNER_SITE =  MESFACILITY_CD and PLANNING STAGE = MESPLANNING_STAGE (Note- map all end planning  stage to the non end mesplanning stage like fab and fab end to fab)
 -create a column WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_SITE_CD_DERIVED and set as - When the PLANNING_STAGE is not end stages i.e., Fab or Bump, take MANUFACTURING_LOCATION_CD(MES LOCATION) else WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_SITE_CD    
 -create a column TO_LOCATION_ID_DERIVED and set as - When the PLANNING_STAGE is End stage i.e., Fab-End or Bump-End, take TO_LOCATION_ID and if it is null then WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_SITE_CD_DERIVED 
 -create a column FINAL_LOCATION_ID when end stages then TO_LOCATION_ID_DERIVED else WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_SITE_CD_DERIVED
 -update column IS_TRANSFORMED and append with comments as per the location used  ' : USED ORIGINAL TO_LOCATION_ID' , ': USED ORIGINAL WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_SITE_CD', ':'USED MES LOCATION'', ''MASTER DATA ISSUE, NEED TO IGNORE''
4- ADD a new column AS INVENTORY_TYPE_CD AND PROJECTION_TYPE 
If Planning_stage like end and WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_SITE_CD and TO_LOCATION_ID is not null then INVENTORY_TYPE_CD =  INTRANSIT and PROJECTION_TYPE  =   INTRANSIT
else BOH and WIP Projection
If planning stage = non end stage then BOH and WIP Projection

5 Update ItemId and location id
Update Final_Item_Id for non end planning stages and  INVENTORY_TYPE_CD =  BOH
 utilize PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_BILL_OF_MATERIAL_LOCATION_TRAVERSAL to traverse the BOM  to find previous stage and its associated Item_Id and update in Final_location_id 
Update Final Location_Id for end planning stage to to_location_id  We have to exclude the record if this Fab item is External which we can find out using Location Master.-- use r2 logic
If the Planning_stage is Fab - No change is done (Shouldn't go to BY, if it occurs we have to remove this case - write a DQ)
7.ADD a new column - LOT7 With LOT_ID first Seven Characters. We are creating this column for the purpose of lot comparison with FSCO Outs.
 
8. Pass the Point_In_Time as Last Saturday Midnight time for example 2025-07-19 23:59:59.00000 and fetch the records from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ENHANCED_INVENTORY_ANALYSIS.WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_PIT

9. Logic for Inventory_Qty:
Update in new column Final_Inventory_Qty and Final_UOM as 'W'
a. If the Unit_of_measure_cd is 'W', no changes are required
b. If the Unit_of_measure_cd is either 'U' or 'D' and Secondary_unit_of_measure_cd is 'W' then replace the Inventory_qty value with Secondary_Qty value.
c If the Unit_of_measure_cd is either 'U' or 'D' and secondary_unit_of_measure_cd is not 'W' then use V_PRM_MANUFACTURING_PARAMETER_ITEM_LOCATION_WORK_WEEK_CORE_PIT view to convert the Unit or Die into Wafer. 
How to Convert the 'U' or 'D' into 'W':
Join the Unified_planning_Item_Id, Work_in_process_Inventory_site_cd from PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_ROOT with Item_Id, Location_Id from PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_PRM_MANUFACTURING_PARAMETER_ITEM_LOCATION_WORK_WEEK_CORE_PIT where Parameter_Nm is 'DPW', FISCAL_WORK_WEEK_NBR = 'CURRENT_WEEK' ('We can get Current_Week by fetching FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR FROM IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_FINANCE_CALENDAR WHERE RELATIVE_DAYS_FROM_TODAY_NBR = '0' ) and  fetch the Parameter_Qty. If this Parameter_Qty is greater than zero then replace the Value of Inventory_qty in Common_Analysis view with the (Inventory_Qty(from Root) / Parameter_Qty (from Manufacturing_Paramter view).
update column  IS_TRANSFORMED and append with comments like NO CHANGES in QTY, USED SECONDARY WAFER QTY, DPW CONVERSION APPLIED

Drop lots if planning site and planning owner site is null and is_transformed = 'MASTER DATA ISSUE, NEED TO IGNORE'

Drop Lot if the Item is an Order Point and Planning Stage is "End" Stage ( sames as r2 logic)
get the list of Items from sku for location = VF and traverse it to previous stage and remove these items from Inventory.

Create column PLANT_CD  and fetch PLANT_CD by joining with V_BRD_PLANT_CODE_MAPPING_CORE_PIT  on fINAL_LOCATION_ID = MANUFACTURING_LOCATION_CD

blocks.text:
1. fetch data from PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_STAGE (CIBR Data)
2. For View  PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_SCH_START_CORE (FSCO/APPS/XEUS Data) filter where LOT_OWNER_CODE in 'P' OR 'PROD'
 -  identify if an item is TurnKey or not  -
   join WITH PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_HYBRID_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT ON ITEM_ID AND GET NSB_FLAG (NSB_FLAG = N IS TURNKEY & Y= NON TURNKEY) and ITEM_ORDER_POINT
  Create a column INVENTORY_TYPE_CD and set as 'SCHED_RCPTS'
2.1 Drop lots as per below logic -- For FFS drop all stages and keep only order pt stage
    if NSB_FLAG = N AND ITEM_ORDER_POINT = N for SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = FFS THEN DROP THE RECORD, KEEP ONLY ITEM_ORDER_POINT= Y
3. For View  PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_SCH_WORK_IN_PROCESS_CORE (FSCO/APPS/XEUS Data)  where LOT_OWNER_CODE in 'P' OR 'PROD'
-  identify if an item is TurnKey or not  -
   join WITH PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_SP_HYBRID_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT ON ITEM_ID AND GET NSB_FLAG (NSB_FLAG = N IS TURNKEY & Y= NON TURNKEY)
  Create a column INVENTORY_TYPE_CD and set as 'SCHED_RCPTS'
3.1 Drop lots as per below logic -- For FFS drop all stages and keep only order pt stage
    if NSB_FLAG = N AND ITEM_ORDER_POINT = N for SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = FFS THEN DROP THE RECORD, KEEP ONLY ITEM_ORDER_POINT= Y

LOT Comparision between FSCO OUTs and CIBR
4. We need to compare data between CIBR and FSCO OUTS ( PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_SCH_WORK_IN_PROCESS_CORE ) where Source_sytem_nm = 'FSCO' AND PROJECTION_TYPE = 'WIP Projection'
If a lot matches, ie exist in both views then (same logic as r2 - PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_WIP_COMPARISON_TRANSFORM )
If the Planning_stages also match & If both the CIBR and FSCO OUTS planning stages are either FAB, BUMP,SORT and so on ie non end planning stage, we will leave them as is in FSCO OUTS , drop CIBR data
&  If the Planning_stages doesn't match, please do the transformation based on the below cases:
     4A.  If the CIBR Planning Stage is Fab_End and FSCO OUTS Planning_stage is Fab then remove this lot from FSCO OUTS. keep CIBR Data
     4B.  If the CIBR Planning Stage is Bump_End and FSCO OUTS Planning_stage is Bump then remove this lot from FSCO OUTS. and so on for all stages
Lot only exists in WIP projection(FSCO OUTS) - No Action is Needed (Expect to only see when new lot created at Fab Stage - Most probably doesn't happen to see this case).
Lot only exists in Inventory(CIBR): No Action is needed

5. Union all 3 views ( step 2, 3, 4 , from step 3 exclude where Source_sytem_nm = 'FSCO' AND PROJECTION_TYPE = 'WIP Projection' as already covered in step 4 ) after lot comparision betwee FSCO Outs and CIBR, keep all the data from APPS and XEUS - Aggregate all 3 views at Item_id. location_id, Inventory_type_cd, schedule_date
Map FINAL_ITEM_ID WITH ITEM_ID , FINAL_INVENTORY_QTY with QTY,PLANT_CD with LOCATION_ID, START_DATE with START_TRANSACTION_PST_TS, DEST_LOCATION_ID WITH TO_LOCATION_ID from CIBR view to final view, all other sources have same naming conventions
6. We need to bring only the records where BATCH_IND ='W' from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_SCH_WORK_IN_PROCESS_CORE and IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_SCH_START_CORE.
6.Fetch data from PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_PURCHASE_ORDER_DETAIL_CORE_PIT  and aggregate at ITEM_ID , PLANT_CD  and get  GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY,OPEN_PO_QTY, and OPEN_PO_DATE,  GOODS_RECEIVED_DT
append this data in the final view based on below logic :
Set SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = 'S4-IF', PROJECTION_TYPE = 'PO', INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'BOH', ITEM_ID = ITEM_ID, LOCATION_ID = PLANT_CD
QTY, SCHEDULE_DATE = ( a. if  GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY =  0  then  OPEN_PO_QTY &  OPEN_PO_DATE
                                           b.  if  open_po_qty = 0 then GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY &  GOODS_RECEIVED_DT
                                           C. if   GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY <> 0 and open_po_qty <> 0 then create two rows one with GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY &   GOODS_RECEIVED_DT and other with OPEN_PO_QTY and OPEN_PO_DATE
7.Fetch data from V_INV_DIE_CONSUMPTION_CORE_PIT where lot_owner_cd = 'P' and aggregate at item_id and plant_cd and append/union the data and set inventory_type_cd = 'SCHED_RCPTS', PROJECTION_TYPE = 'WIP Projection' AND MAP ITEM_ID, PLANT_CD AND SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM AND PARAMETER_QTY

8. Fetch ITEM_ID, PLANT_CD AS LOCATION_ID ,  LOT_UNRESTRICTED_QTY AS QTY,SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM, POSTING_PERIOD_FISCAL_YEAR_NBR, POSTING_PERIOD_NBR from V_INV_ITEM_STORAGE_LOCATION_LOT_INVENTORY_CORE_PIT jOIN WITH CALENDAR VIEW ON FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR USING POSTING_PERIOD_FISCAL_YEAR_NBR AS YEAR AND  POSTING_PERIOD_NBR AS WW AND FETCH AS OF SATURDAY DATE AS 'SCHEDULE_DATE'
aggregate QTY FROM ABOVE VIEW ON ITEM_ID, LOCATION_ID AND 'SCHEDULE_DATE'
SET PROJECTION_TYPE = 'Balance Starts' , INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'BOH'
append the data in the final combined view

9.) Supplier Substrate data (BOH):

Query YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR from  PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_SUBSTRATE_ITEM_SUPPLIER_INVENTORY_DETAIL_CORE_PIT to:

IF YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR = CURRENT WORKWEEK :
   SET SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = 'E2 Open',
          PROJECTION_TYPE = 'Balance Starts',
          INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'BOH'
          LOCATION_ID = 'VF_S'
   Fetch ITEM_ID,
             ITEM_FINISHED_GOODS_QTY  AS QTY,
             YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR
   from PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_SUBSTRATE_ITEM_SUPPLIER_INVENTORY_DETAIL_CORE_PIT
   join WITH CALENDAR VIEW ON FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR =YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR
   and Fetch as of SATURDAY DATE for current WW (YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR) AS SCHEDULE_DATE
   QTY = aggregate QTY FROM ABOVE VIEW ON ITEM_ID, LOCATION_ID AND SCHEDULE_DATE

IF YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR = FUTURE WORKWEEK :
   SET SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = 'E2 Open',
          PROJECTION_TYPE = 'Projected BOH',
          INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'BOH'
          LOCATION_ID = 'VF_S'
   Fetch ITEM_ID,
             ITEM_FINISHED_GOODS_QTY  AS QTY,
             YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR
   from PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_SUBSTRATE_ITEM_SUPPLIER_INVENTORY_DETAIL_CORE_PIT

context.text: We will get the START_DATE and SCHEDULE_DATE from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_SCH_WORK_IN_PROCESS_CORE (from Varun's Design)

statements: 1. fetch data from PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_STAGE (CIBR Data)
2. For View  PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_SCH_START_CORE (FSCO/APPS/XEUS Data) filter where LOT_OWNER_CODE in 'P' OR 'PROD'

-  identify if an item is TurnKey or not  - join WITH PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_HYBRID_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT ON ITEM_ID AND GET NSB_FLAG (NSB_FLAG = N IS TURNKEY & Y= NON TURNKEY) and ITEM_ORDER_POINT Create a column INVENTORY_TYPE_CD and set as 'SCHED_RCPTS'

2.1 Drop lots as per below logic -- For FFS drop all stages and keep only order pt stage if NSB_FLAG = N AND ITEM_ORDER_POINT = N for SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = FFS THEN DROP THE RECORD, KEEP ONLY ITEM_ORDER_POINT= Y
3. For View  PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_SCH_WORK_IN_PROCESS_CORE (FSCO/APPS/XEUS Data)  where LOT_OWNER_CODE in 'P' OR 'PROD'

-  identify if an item is TurnKey or not  - join WITH PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_SP_HYBRID_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT ON ITEM_ID AND GET NSB_FLAG (NSB_FLAG = N IS TURNKEY & Y= NON TURNKEY) Create a column INVENTORY_TYPE_CD and set as 'SCHED_RCPTS'

3.1 Drop lots as per below logic -- For FFS drop all stages and keep only order pt stage if NSB_FLAG = N AND ITEM_ORDER_POINT = N for SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = FFS THEN DROP THE RECORD, KEEP ONLY ITEM_ORDER_POINT= Y LOT Comparision between FSCO OUTs and CIBR

4. We need to compare data between CIBR and FSCO OUTS ( PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_SCH_WORK_IN_PROCESS_CORE ) where Source_sytem_nm = 'FSCO' AND PROJECTION_TYPE = 'WIP Projection' If a lot matches, ie exist in both views then (same logic as r2 - PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_WIP_COMPARISON_TRANSFORM ) If the Planning_stages also match & If both the CIBR and FSCO OUTS planning stages are either FAB, BUMP,SORT and so on ie non end planning stage, we will leave them as is in FSCO OUTS , drop CIBR data &  If the Planning_stages doesn't match, please do the transformation based on the below cases:
4A.  If the CIBR Planning Stage is Fab_End and FSCO OUTS Planning_stage is Fab then remove this lot from FSCO OUTS. keep CIBR Data

4B.  If the CIBR Planning Stage is Bump_End and FSCO OUTS Planning_stage is Bump then remove this lot from FSCO OUTS. and so on for all stages Lot only exists in WIP projection(FSCO OUTS) - No Action is Needed (Expect to only see when new lot created at Fab Stage - Most probably doesn't happen to see this case). Lot only exists in Inventory(CIBR): No Action is needed

5. Union all 3 views ( step 2, 3, 4 , from step 3 exclude where Source_sytem_nm = 'FSCO' AND PROJECTION_TYPE = 'WIP Projection' as already covered in step 4 ) after lot comparision betwee FSCO Outs and CIBR, keep all the data from APPS and XEUS - Aggregate all 3 views at Item_id. location_id, Inventory_type_cd, schedule_date Map FINAL_ITEM_ID WITH ITEM_ID , FINAL_INVENTORY_QTY with QTY,PLANT_CD with LOCATION_ID, START_DATE with START_TRANSACTION_PST_TS, DEST_LOCATION_ID WITH TO_LOCATION_ID from CIBR view to final view, all other sources have same naming conventions
6. We need to bring only the records where BATCH_IND ='W' from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_SCH_WORK_IN_PROCESS_CORE and IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_SCH_START_CORE.

6.Fetch data from PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_PURCHASE_ORDER_DETAIL_CORE_PIT  and aggregate at ITEM_ID , PLANT_CD  and get  GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY,OPEN_PO_QTY, and OPEN_PO_DATE,  GOODS_RECEIVED_DT append this data in the final view based on below logic : Set SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = 'S4-IF', PROJECTION_TYPE = 'PO', INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'BOH', ITEM_ID = ITEM_ID, LOCATION_ID = PLANT_CD QTY, SCHEDULE_DATE = ( a. if  GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY =  0  then  OPEN_PO_QTY &  OPEN_PO_DATE
b.  if  open_po_qty = 0 then GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY &  GOODS_RECEIVED_DT
C. if   GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY <> 0 and open_po_qty <> 0 then create two rows one with GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY &   GOODS_RECEIVED_DT and other with OPEN_PO_QTY and OPEN_PO_DATE

7.Fetch data from V_INV_DIE_CONSUMPTION_CORE_PIT where lot_owner_cd = 'P' and aggregate at item_id and plant_cd and append/union the data and set inventory_type_cd = 'SCHED_RCPTS', PROJECTION_TYPE = 'WIP Projection' AND MAP ITEM_ID, PLANT_CD AND SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM AND PARAMETER_QTY

8. Fetch ITEM_ID, PLANT_CD AS LOCATION_ID ,  LOT_UNRESTRICTED_QTY AS QTY,SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM, POSTING_PERIOD_FISCAL_YEAR_NBR, POSTING_PERIOD_NBR from V_INV_ITEM_STORAGE_LOCATION_LOT_INVENTORY_CORE_PIT jOIN WITH CALENDAR VIEW ON FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR USING POSTING_PERIOD_FISCAL_YEAR_NBR AS YEAR AND  POSTING_PERIOD_NBR AS WW AND FETCH AS OF SATURDAY DATE AS 'SCHEDULE_DATE' aggregate QTY FROM ABOVE VIEW ON ITEM_ID, LOCATION_ID AND 'SCHEDULE_DATE' SET PROJECTION_TYPE = 'Balance Starts' , INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'BOH' append the data in the final combined view
